arguments.command:
V=/mnt/home/yqi10/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages
echo "== Q1: files in vllm defining a class ending in ForCausalLM =="
Q1=$(grep -rlE "^[[:space:]]*class[[:space:]]+[[:alnum:]_]*ForCausalLM([^[:alnum:]_]|$)" --include="*.py" "$V/vllm" | sort)
echo "$Q1"
echo "Q1 count: $(echo "$Q1" | grep -c .)"
echo "== Q2: modeling_*.py under transformers/models with top-level def apply_rotary_pos_emb =="
Q2=$(find "$V/transformers/models" -type f -name "modeling_*.py" -exec grep -l "^def apply_rotary_pos_emb(" {} + | sort)
echo "$Q2"
echo "Q2 count: $(echo "$Q2" | grep -c .)"
